string.name: library_subtitle
string.value: Your books, at your own pace.

string.name: empty_description
string.value: Add books from your device to start reading. No internet connection required.

string.name: kosync_description
string.value: Synchronize reading progress using the same server, account, and EPUB on each device. Book files are managed separately.

string.name: kosync_connect_description
string.value: Connect to your KOReader Sync server.

string.name: password_unchanged
string.value: Leave empty to keep saved password

string.name: newer_wins
string.value: The newer position wins. Missing or tied timestamps require a choice. Keep device clocks accurate.

string.name: about_description
string.value: Readest for HarmonyOS offers a focused EPUB reading experience with an organized bookshelf, customizable reading appearance, and cross-device reading progress synchronization.

string.name: conflict_description
string.value: Reading progress differs between devices. Choose where to continue; automatic uploads are paused until you choose.

string.name: remove_description
string.value: Remove this book and its local reading data?

string.name: error_https_required
string.value: Enter a valid HTTPS server URL.

string.name: error_not_kosync
string.value: This URL did not return a KoSync JSON response.

string.name: error_credentials_unavailable
string.value: Saved credentials could not be decrypted. Connect again.

string.name: error_duplicate_book
string.value: This EPUB is already in your library.

string.name: error_invalid_epub
string.value: This file is not a valid EPUB.

string.name: error_drm_or_encrypted
string.value: Encrypted or DRM-protected EPUBs are not supported.

string.name: error_fixed_layout_unsupported
string.value: Fixed-layout EPUBs are not supported in this release.

string.name: error_book_too_large
string.value: The book is empty or exceeds the supported size (128 MB compressed / 512 MB expanded).

string.name: error_unresolved_position
string.value: The server position could not be restored. Automatic upload is paused. Check that both apps use the same EPUB, then retry syncing.

string.name: error_network_timeout
string.value: The sync server did not respond in time. Check the tablet network, VPN or Wi-Fi proxy, then retry.

string.name: error_network_dns
string.value: The sync server address could not be resolved. Check the server URL and network DNS.

string.name: error_network_tls
string.value: A secure connection to the sync server could not be verified. Check the device clock and server certificate.

string.name: error_network_error
string.value: The sync server could not be reached. Check the network, VPN or Wi-Fi proxy, then retry.

string.name: error_import_timeout
string.value: Reading this EPUB took too long. Select the file again.

string.name: error_reader_timeout
string.value: The book could not be opened in time. Try opening it again.

string.name: error_server_error
string.value: The sync server returned an error. Retry later.

string.name: error_invalid_progress
string.value: The server returned an invalid reading position.

string.name: error_generic
string.value: The operation could not be completed. Please try again. Your saved reading data is retained.

string.name: preview_text
string.value: A book is a dream that you hold in your hands.

string.name: error_import_read_failed
string.value: The EPUB could not be read from your device. Select the file again.

string.name: error_import_write_failed
string.value: The EPUB could not be saved. Check available device storage.

string.name: error_book_not_found
string.value: The local book file could not be found. Import the EPUB again.
